'use server'

import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { refresh } from 'next/cache'

const NOTIFICATIONS_COOKIE = 'notifications-enabled'

export async function toggleNotificationPreference() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies()
  const isEnabled = cookieStore.get(NOTIFICATIONS_COOKIE)?.value === 'true'

  cookieStore.set(NOTIFICATIONS_COOKIE, String(!isEnabled), {
    httpOnly: true,
    sameSite: 'lax',
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
    path: '/',
    maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365,
  })

  refresh()
}
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
import './globals.css'

export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Notification settings',
  description: 'Manage your notification preference.',
}

export default function RootLayout({ children }: Readonly<{ children: React.ReactNode }>) {
  return (
    <html lang="en">
      <body>{children}</body>
    </html>
  )
}

item.text:
Implemented the notification preference toggle. The Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts) flips a cookie and calls `refresh()` from `next/cache`, so the current page re-renders without redirecting. [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx) reads the saved preference and displays the updated status.

The preference is stored in a browser cookie, since the project has no account or database storage. I also added the required root layout and page styling. I did not run tests.
